metadata.name: hookwars_market
metadata.description: Hookwars (units): items as assets (docs/spec/10-expansion.md): listings and sales, collections, item rental, commissions.

instructions.name: accept_lease
docs: Anyone accepts an offered lease, paying its fee to the lessor; the term starts now.

instructions.name: apply_licence_params
docs: Anyone applies pending licence parameters once ready.

instructions.name: apply_params
docs: Anyone applies a pending params change once it is ready.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buys a listed item. The buyer pays the protocol fee, the author's resale share and the
seller directly; the escrow sends the item token to the buyer.

instructions.name: buy_license
docs: Buys (or, while live, extends) a licence for a token; pays the 2.3 split.

instructions.name: create_collection
docs: Creates a collection of active templates (discovery only, 10 section 1.5).

instructions.name: delist
docs: The seller takes the item back.

instructions.name: end_lease
docs: Anyone ends a lease after its term; the item returns to the lessor. Reverting the slot (if
the item is still equipped there) is the armory's `revert_for_lease_end` (integration
request in 10).

instructions.name: expire
docs: Anyone returns an expired listing to its seller.

instructions.name: expire_license
docs: Anyone frees the live slot of an ended licence.

instructions.name: init
docs: Creates the config; the program's upgrade authority signs.

instructions.name: init_licence_config
docs: The market admin creates the licence parameters.

instructions.name: list
docs: Lists an item: its token moves into the escrow until it sells, is delisted or expires.

instructions.name: offer_lease
docs: Offers an item for rent to one token's slot. The item token moves into the lease escrow
until the offer is withdrawn or the lease ends.

instructions.name: open_commission
docs: Opens a commission: a bounty for an item a token's community wants in a vote-chosen slot.

instructions.name: pay_commission
docs: Anyone pays the bounty to a submission's submitter once that item is equipped in the slot
(and was not the incumbent when the commission opened), after the submission window.

instructions.name: propose_licence_params
docs: The market admin proposes new licence parameters (applied after the timelock).

instructions.name: propose_params
docs: The admin proposes new params and treasury; they apply after `admin_timelock_secs`.

instructions.name: refund_commission
docs: Anyone refunds the bounty to the creator when no submission was equipped in time.

instructions.name: renew_license
docs: Renews an existing licence by one term at the offer's price.

instructions.name: revoke_license
docs: The holder revokes a per-period licence and refunds the unused fraction.

instructions.name: set_licence_offer
docs: The item holder sets (or closes, `active = false`) its licence terms.

instructions.name: submit
docs: The holder of an item submits it while the commission is open.

instructions.name: withdraw_offer
docs: The lessor withdraws an offer nobody accepted; the item returns.

types.name: Collection
docs: `Collection` at `["collection", id]` (10 section 1.5). Discovery only, no economic effect.

types.name: Commission
docs: `Commission` at `["commission", token_mint, nonce]` (10 section 5.2).

fields.name: incumbent
docs: The item in the slot when the commission opened (a payment needs a different one).

types.name: Lease
docs: `Lease` at `["lease", item]` (10 section 4.2). Closed when it ends or is withdrawn.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The token that may equip the item during the term.

fields.name: rent_bps
docs: Share of the item's royalty paid to the lessor during the term (R32: never on top).

fields.name: fee_lamports
docs: Paid once to the lessor by whoever accepts.

types.name: LicenceConfig
docs: `LicenceConfig` at `["licence-config"]` (admin = the market admin).

types.name: LicenceOffer
docs: `LicenceOffer` at `["licence-offer", item]`.

fields.name: max_live
docs: How many tokens may hold a live licence at once (1 with `exclusive`).

types.name: LicenceParams
docs: Licence parameters (11 section 11; every one "to set").

fields.name: protocol_bps
docs: `LICENCE_PROTOCOL_BPS`.

fields.name: author_bps
docs: The template author's share of the remainder, until `Template.author_bps` exists (R34).

fields.name: min_secs
docs: `LICENCE_MIN_SECS`, `LICENCE_MAX_SECS`.

types.name: License
docs: `License` at `["license", item, token_mint]`.

fields.name: price_paid
docs: Paid since `starts_at` (the span a revocation refunds against).

fields.name: revoked_at
docs: 0 = not revoked.

fields.name: counted
docs: Whether it holds one of the offer's live slots.

types.name: Listing
docs: `Listing` at `["listing", item_mint]` (10 section 1.1). One live listing per item.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: 0 = never expires.

types.name: MarketConfig
docs: `MarketConfig` at `["market-config"]`.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Wallet that receives the protocol's share of sales.

fields.name: collections
docs: Collections created so far (the next id).

types.name: MarketParams
docs: The market's parameters (10 section 13; every one "to set").

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: `MARKET_FEE_BPS`: the protocol's share of a sale price.

fields.name: author_resale_bps
docs: `AUTHOR_RESALE_BPS`: the item author's share of a sale price.

fields.name: collection_max_templates
docs: `COLLECTION_MAX_TEMPLATES`.

fields.name: max_rent_bps
docs: `MAX_RENT_BPS`: the most of an item's royalty a lease may assign to the lessor (R32).

fields.name: lease_min_secs
docs: `LEASE_MIN_SECS`.

fields.name: lease_max_secs
docs: `LEASE_MAX_SECS`.

fields.name: commission_min_lamports
docs: `COMMISSION_MIN_LAMPORTS`.

fields.name: commission_vote_secs
docs: `COMMISSION_VOTE_SECS`: after a commission closes, how long the slot has to equip a
submission before anyone may refund the bounty.

fields.name: admin_timelock_secs
docs: `ADMIN_TIMELOCK_SECS` (00): delay on every params change.

types.name: PendingMarketParams
docs: `PendingMarketParams` at `["market-pending"]`: a params change waiting for its delay.

types.name: ProtocolFee
docs: Every protocol collection (11 section 2.4); `mint` is the default key for native lamports.

types.name: Submission
docs: `Submission` at `["submission", commission, item]`.
